title: enterolobium guaraniticum
intro: Enterolobium guaraniticum, commonly known as the Caja tree or Tahuari tree, is a species of flowering plant in the family Fabaceae. This tree is native to the tropical regions of Central and South America, and its pods have been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Enterolobium guaraniticum include its potential to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and act as an antioxidant, which can help protect against cell damage and oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and diuretic properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, among others.
